title: Payment FAQ Version 1 | Meridian Assure
content:
How can I pay my insurance premium online?
To pay your insurance premium online, visit the official Meridian QuickPay web portal at pay.meridianassure.com. Enter your 10-digit policy number and date of birth to view your outstanding premium amount. You can complete the transaction using UPI, debit card, credit card, or internet banking. Once the payment is verified, an instant digital receipt and updated policy renewal certificate will be sent directly to your registered email address.

title: Payment FAQ Version 2 | Meridian Assure
content:
How do I make my insurance premium payment online?
To pay your insurance premium online, please go to the official Meridian QuickPay web portal at pay.meridianassure.com. Simply enter your 10-digit policy number along with your date of birth to check your pending premium due. You may finalize the transaction using UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking. Once your transaction is confirmed, an instant payment receipt and renewed certificate will be emailed directly to your registered email account.

title: MERIDIAN ASSURE — NUDGE & COMPLIANCE PLAYBOOK
content:
Real-Time Call Nudge Guidelines and Approved Texts (Q4)
> Strict Rule: All compliance and behavioral nudges delivered to human advisors must not exceed 18 words.

1. Mandatory Compliance Disclosures (P0)
- **Call Recording Consent:**
 - *Trigger:* Within the first 25 seconds of an answered call.
 - *Approved Nudge Text:* "Mandatory: Inform customer this call is recorded for quality and regulatory compliance." (12 words)
- **Grace Period Accuracy Notice:**
 - *Trigger:* Advisor mentions grace period or policy lapse terms.
 - *Approved Nudge Text:* "Clarify: 30-day grace period applies for annual renewal; full coverage remains active." (12 words)
- **Statutory Free-Look Right:**
 - *Trigger:* Customer agrees to new policy issuance or upgraded rider.
 - *Approved Nudge Text:* "Disclose 15-day free-look cancellation window with 100% premium refund rights." (10 words)

2. Escalation & Frustration Triggers (P1)
- **Customer Anger / Threat of Regulatory Complaint:**
 - *Trigger:* Customer mentions "Ombudsman", "Lawyer", "Consumer Court", or elevated acoustic pitch.
 - *Approved Nudge Text:* "De-escalate immediately. Empathize with customer frustration and offer senior supervisor transfer." (11 words)
- **Vulnerability / Financial Hardship:**
 - *Trigger:* Customer mentions bereavement, job loss, or serious hospitalization.
 - *Approved Nudge Text:* "Acknowledge hardship with empathy. Offer quarterly payment schedule or hardship grace extension." (12 words)

3. Cross-Sell & Opportunity Nudges (P2)
- **Multi-Vehicle / Hospital Cash Cross-Sell:**
 - *Trigger:* Customer affirms family renewal commitment.
 - *Approved Nudge Text:* "Customer eligible for Hospital Cash rider at ₹49/month with 20% family floater discount." (13 words)
- **Digital Auto-Pay Enrollment:**
 - *Trigger:* Customer asks about payment methods.
 - *Approved Nudge Text:* "Offer UPI AutoPay enrollment for instant 5% cashback on future renewals." (11 words)

title: MERIDIAN ASSURE — OBJECTION HANDLING PLAYBOOK
content:
Objection 1: "The premium is too high this year"
- **Empathy & Validation:** "I completely understand managing annual expenses can feel heavy, especially right now."
- **Value Anchor:** "Your Meridian Shield policy currently holds ₹5,00,000 in sum insured, plus you've accumulated a 20% Cumulative No-Claim Bonus (additional ₹1,00,000 cover at zero extra cost). If the policy lapses, that accrued bonus resets to zero."
- **Alternative Option:** "We can switch your billing frequency to quarterly or semi-annual payments to reduce your immediate out-of-pocket payment today."

Objection 2: "I didn't make any claims last year, so this policy is a waste of money"
- **Empathy & Validation:** "It's wonderful that you and your family stayed healthy throughout the past twelve months."
- **Value Anchor:** "Insurance is protection for unexpected medical emergencies. Moreover, because you made no claims, your No-Claim Bonus increased your coverage, and your Pre-Existing Disease waiting period is now 12 months closer to full waiver."
- **Health Checkup Reminder:** "Don't forget you also have a complimentary annual health checkup voucher worth ₹2,500 that you can utilize this week."

Objection 3: "I want to switch to a competitor insurer"
- **Portability Protocol:** "You have the legal right to port your policy to any IRDAI-registered insurer under portability regulations. However, portability applications must be submitted at least 45 days prior to your renewal date."
- **Risk Disclosure:** "If you let this policy lapse now to start fresh elsewhere, your 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period clock resets to zero at the new insurer."

Objection 4: "I don't have the money right now, call me back next month"
- **Grace Period Clarification:** "You don't need to risk losing your cover today. Under IRDAI guidelines, your policy has a full 30-day grace period from your due date during which you remain fully covered."
- **Commitment:** "Shall I schedule an automated SMS payment link for the 25th day of your grace period, or would you like to break this into quarterly instalments?"

title: MERIDIAN ASSURE — OFFICIAL POLICY WORDING
content:
Section 1: Scope of Coverage
The Company agrees, subject to terms, exclusions, and conditions herein contained, to pay a Daily Hospital Cash Benefit in the event of continuous hospitalisation exceeding 24 hours due to covered illness or accidental bodily injury.

Section 2: Daily Allowance Benefit Schedule
1. **Standard Inpatient Care:** ₹3,000 per day up to a cumulative maximum of 90 days per policy year.
2. **Intensive Care Unit (ICU):** ₹6,000 per day (2x standard allowance) up to a cumulative maximum of 15 days per policy year.
3. **Convalescence Allowance:** Lump sum ₹10,000 in the event of hospitalisation exceeding 10 consecutive days.

Section 3: Pre-Existing Disease (PED) Waiting Period
Coverage for Pre-Existing Diseases commences only after thirty-six (36) months of continuous coverage from the initial policy inception date, provided renewal premiums have been remitted without lapse.

Section 4.1 Payment Mode
Premiums may be paid annually, half-yearly, or quarterly via authorised electronic channels (NEFT, UPI, Direct Debit, Credit Card).

Section 4.2 Grace Period (Statutory IRDAI Rule)
A grace period of thirty (30) calendar days from the scheduled due date shall be allowed for payment of yearly, half-yearly, and quarterly premiums. For monthly payment frequencies, the grace period shall be fifteen (15) days. During the thirty (30) day grace period, the policy insurance coverage shall remain continuously in force, and valid hospitalisation claims arising during this window shall be honored subject to deduction of overdue premium.

Section 5: Revival of Lapsed Policies
If premium is not remitted before the expiry of the 30-day grace period, the policy lapses. A lapsed policy may be revived within six (6) months of the due date upon submission of a Good Health Declaration and remittance of all unpaid dues plus a nominal revival charge.

title: MERIDIAN SHIELD HEALTH PROTECTION BROCHURE
content:
Product Overview
Meridian Shield is our flagship health insurance plan providing sum insured options from ₹5 Lakhs to ₹50 Lakhs. It covers inpatient hospitalisation, day care treatments, ambulance costs, organ donor expenses, and annual health checkups.

Premium Rate Table (Annual Base Premium in INR)
Below is the standard indicative rate schedule for Individual coverage (₹5,00,000 Sum Insured, Tier-1 City):

| Age Band | Base Premium (Annual) | Monthly Equivalent |
|---|---|---|
| 18 – 25 years | ₹4,800 | ₹420 |
| 26 – 35 years | ₹6,500 | ₹570 |
| 36 – 40 years | ₹8,400 | ₹740 |
| 41 – 45 years | ₹10,800 | ₹950 | <!-- PLANTED TYPO: 10,800 / 950 instead of ₹10,800 / ₹950 -->

| 51 – 55 years | ₹18,000 | ₹1,580 |
| 56 – 60 years | ₹24,000 | ₹2,100 |

*Note: Taxes applicable as per prevailing GST norms.*

Free-Look Period
Policyholders have a period of 15 days from receipt of the policy document to review the terms. If dissatisfied, the policy may be cancelled with full refund minus stamp duty and proportionate risk premium.

title: Branch Partnership Benefits | Meridian Assure
content:
Branch Partnership Benefits
Empowering banking partners with streamlined bancassurance products and co-located servicing. Overview Meridian Assure offers dedicated branch partnership privileges to institutional banking networks across tier-1 and tier-2 locations. Under this agreement, partner bank branches serve as certified distribution nodes for health, life, and credit-shield insurance solutions. Key Partner Privileges Reciprocal Referral Fees: Bank branches earn an upfront referral commission of 12.5% on all primary health and hospital cash policy issuances routed through official partner desks. Co-Located Claims Concierge: High-volume branches receive a dedicated Meridian Claims Liaison officer on-site to assist policyholders with cashless pre-authorization and instant claim settlement documentation within 48 hours. Instant Digital Endorsements: Core banking integration enables immediate real-time policy issuance via API, eliminating paper documentation and shortening turnaround to under 90 seconds. Dedicated Partner Escalation Hotline: Direct priority telephony routing (1800-PARTNER-ASSURE) connecting branch managers to Senior Underwriting Directors. Eligibility and Compliance Branch eligibility requires maintaining a valid corporate agency license under IRDAI guidelines, alongside mandatory bi-annual compliance training for all customer-facing relationship managers.

title: Policy Renewal FAQ | Meridian Assure
content:
How many days do I have to pay my renewal before my policy lapses?
Meridian Assure allows a grace period of 30 days (Statutory IRDAI §4.2 rule: 30 days for annual, 15 days for monthly) from your renewal date to complete your premium payment. If payment is not received within 30 days (Statutory IRDAI §4.2 rule: 30 days for annual, 15 days for monthly), your policy will lapse immediately and benefits will terminate.
